title: Winter Survival
description: It’s cold. It’s quiet. And you’re not sure everything around you is real. Winter Survival is about staying alive in abandoned world with your descending mind.
body:
It can be a challenge to survive here, but give it a try. The first thing you'll need is a roof over your head. Find a shelter or build one yourself, and make it quick, because the cold doesn't wait. Don't just throw up four walls either, insulate what you can, since a drafty shack won't do much good once the storms roll in.
![Scary caves](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/14061826d3dc0741b496a20498268596a0b734ad_0.webp)
Animals are rare, so if you spot one, don't waste the chance, you'll need a lot of luck to find more. If you manage to catch a few, keep them close and feed them, they're worth more alive than as a one-time meal. 
![Abandoned house](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d487fd810514094bb4913008c7d557715aef6ae.png)
You'll have to face the bitter cold. To warm up set up a fire in a cave or any other structure you can find, and keep it burning as long as you can. Warm clothes help too, so don't ignore anything that holds heat, even if it looks rotten.
![Snowy forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/227fb46b9b11029abd59418ac2374e2e10e879e6.png)
Build up your gear bit by bit, stay close to the fire when you can, and don't go too far without a plan to get back. The cold isn't the only thing you'll need to watch out for, so keep your eyes open and don't get too comfortable.

Good luck and have fun.

Following a thorough review of your application and interview, we are pleased to offer you the position of researcher at Nuclear Technology & Research.

Your primary responsibilities and duties will include:

2.	Soil analysis, search and study of various minerals and sending reports to the office.
Your first day of employment is scheduled for 18 July, 2017.

We are confident that your expertise and professional qualities will be a valuable asset to our team and will significantly contribute to the success of our projects and the advancement of Nuclear Technology & Research.
We look forward to a successful and productive collaboration.
